title: Final Electric Field
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly derive the electric field E' as seen by observer B.

title: Final Magnetic Field
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly derive the magnetic field B' as seen by observer B.

title: Charge Density Derivation
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly derive the charge density rho' in the wire as seen by observer B.

title: Velocity Transformations
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly apply the Lorentz transformation to find the velocities of the electron and ion streams.

title: Charge Density Explanation
description: Important Criteria: The student must provide a clear explanation for the presence of charge density seen by observer B but not by A.

title: Sign Mistakes
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid common sign mistakes in the derivation of electric and magnetic fields.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must ensure that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.
